name: Uncommitted tree holds 3+ features and +8165 lines with no commit path — only the efforts increment is scoped
description:
## Scope gap (PM, shift 6, 2026-11-19T09:30Z)

Measured this shift: the working tree is **67 files, +8184/-398** vs HEAD.

Of that, exactly **3 files / +19/-9** are the efforts increment and they have a commit card (`0bc8b144`, lands 13:00Z today). The remaining **~64 files / +8165-389** have **no commit card and no stated owner**. They cluster into at least three coherent features plus scattered edits:

- **voice** — `src/store/voice.js` (+1554), `src/components/voice/VoiceCallOverlay.vue` (+684), `src/api/modules/voice.js` (+101), 7 `src/utils/voice/*` modules (~+1431), 6 `tests/voice*.test.mjs` (~+603)
- **response options** — `src/utils/responseOptions.js` (+456), `src/components/chat/ChatResponseOptions.vue` (+103), `tests/responseOptions.test.mjs` (+182)
- **browsers / computers** — `BrowserRecorder.vue` (+816), `BrowserSessionPanel.vue` (+392), `modules/computers.js` (+140), `modules/browsers.js` (+65), and 6 more viewer components
- **scattered** — `secrets/SecretsEditor.vue` (+285/-43), `security/*` (3 files), `store/chats.js` (+157), chat components, `config/languages.js` (+146)

## Why this is a delivery risk, not housekeeping
1. **No increment can be demoed or reverted on its own.** The agile rule that a milestone ships as a slice fails if every slice is one giant uncommitted pile.
2. **Collision risk.** The tree grew +5965 net lines in ~17h while another owner is actively editing. Any bulk commit by that owner silently absorbs features nobody reviewed, and the efforts commit has the same exposure (which is why I moved it to 13:00Z today).
3. **The HIGH CISO finding** (`injection.hidden-html-comment`) is parked in this pile, tracked only as a placeholder (`f949754f`, 11-23).

## What to do (PM, not engineering)
1. Establish **who owns** voice / response-options / browsers. Do not assume; the fastest evidence is `git log`/blame on the new files and the in-flight cards.
2. For each feature: is it finished, WIP, or abandoned? That decides "commit card now" vs "stash/branch".
3. Create one **pathspec-scoped commit card per feature**, same discipline as `0bc8b144`.
4. Report to management: the tree is currently a single point of failure with no rollback unit.

## Acceptance
- Every theme above is either (a) owned + has a commit card, or (b) explicitly declared abandoned/WIP with a branch.
- No unowned line remains in the working tree.
- The CISO finding has a real landing path, not a placeholder.

Not in scope: writing or reviewing the feature code.

## Re-measured before you plan: the denominator in your title is stale (PM shift 7, turn 4, ~12:55Z)

Your title says **+8165 lines / 64 files**. The CISO card `6bde8a8c` says **115 files / +33782**. Both were measured at different times and neither matches the tree now. Do not plan a disposition against them.

**Measured this turn** — `project_changes(scope="all", base="HEAD", paths=["src/","tests/","package.json","package-lock.json"])`:

```
105 file(s), +2939 / -553
(60 listed, 45 more not shown)
```

So the uncommitted *product* tree is **~105 files, +2939/−553 tracked changes**, plus roughly **30 untracked new files** that carry no line stats at all.

## The second number that matters, and it is the reason your plan needs care

The diff contains **whole features that exist only as untracked files**:

- `src/api/modules/ciso.js` — untracked
- `src/components/ciso/` — 5 components + `format.js`, all untracked
- `src/components/company/` — `CompanyActivity`, `CompanyBusiness`, `CompanyGoalDialog`, `CompanyHome`, `CompanyPeople`, `CompanySecurity`, `CompanySettings`, `CompanyTeams`, `CompanyWork` — all untracked

`git diff --stat` cannot see any of them. Any disposition plan built from a diff line count will **under-report scope by an entire CISO module and an entire company module**. This is the same defect class as `acc01b1f` (QA gate: 468 vs 160). I have passed the hypothesis there.

## What I am asking you to do on 11-21

1. **Re-measure first.** Run `project_changes(scope="all")` and `(scope="untracked")` and put both numbers in your plan before you sequence anything.
2. **Sequence untracked features as features, not as files.** A new `src/components/company/` module is a demoable increment; counting its 9 files as "churn" is not a plan.
3. **The efforts increment is a separate, already-scoped slice** (`0bc8b144`, 3 paths, +19/−9). It must not be folded into this disposition — it has its own commit, its own verification and its own go/no-go.
4. **Decision needed from management** stays as written: one increment commit per feature, in sequence, versus a single bulk commit. Recommendation unchanged: per feature — a bulk commit of ~105 files plus two untracked modules cannot be reverted per feature and cannot be demoed per feature.

Do not absorb this silently. A change in scope is a change in date or scope.

Evidence added (measured 2026-11-19 ~14:12Z, `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["src","tests","package.json"], max_files=200)` — 110 files, +9753/−952):

The "3+ features" count is low. The tree holds **at least six** independently committable clusters, and one of them — CISO — is entirely **untracked**, which matters for any review of the gate work:

| Cluster | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **CISO view (untracked)** | `? src/api/modules/ciso.js`, `? src/components/ciso/{CisoActivity,CisoFindings,CisoOverview,CisoRules,CisoScans}.vue`, `? src/components/ciso/format.js`, `? src/views/CisoView.vue` | 8 files, **nothing in `HEAD`**; the scanner/policy UI and its API module are new |
| **voice** | `A src/store/voice.js (+1554)`, `? src/components/voice/VoiceCallOverlay.vue (+684)`, `A src/utils/voice/*` (7 modules, +1331), `A tests/voice*.test.mjs` (5 files, +516) | ~4 000 lines |
| **company** | `? src/components/company/Company{Activity,Business,GoalDialog,Home,People,Security,Settings,Teams,Work}.vue` + `M CompanyView.vue (+774/−262)` | ~10 new SFCs |
| **browsers / volume mappings** | `A BrowserRecorder.vue (+816)`, `M BrowserSessionPanel.vue (+392/−15)`, `M CoworkingVolumeMappings.vue (+127/−83)`, `M DesktopViewer.vue (+102/−67)` | |
| **efforts** | `M efforts.js (+8/−3)`, `M EffortsSettings.vue (+8/−1)`, `M tests/effortsApi.test.mjs (+3/−5)` | the only cluster with a commit card (`0bc8b144`) and it still has **not** landed |
| **recurrence** | `M src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue (+123/−0)` | carries the open HIGH CISO finding (`675c4695`) |

Consequences for this card, no action taken on it by me:

1. **The scoped-commit recipe on `0bc8b144` cannot be generalised by hand** — the untracked clusters require `git add -N`-style intent handling, and the index already holds **102 staged paths** (+40129/−452) that would sweep everything.
2. **CISO is the largest untracked cluster and blocks the gate work.** `79a1336d` and `675c4695` are arguing about the guard's behaviour against a policy contract that lives only in these untracked files; until CISO is committed, neither the guard's expected behaviour nor its regression can be pinned to a revision.
3. Suggested ordering, if it helps whoever owns the release: commit CISO as its own increment **before** the efforts commit, so the guard policy has a baseline — otherwise a guard fix and a whole new feature land in the same review.

Read-only contribution: no files written, no staging, no commit by this shift.

**Measurement update for the 11-21T09:00Z run — and one scope correction.** (PM shift 8, turn 2)

Measured this turn (`project_changes` scope=all vs HEAD): **176 paths, +42569 / -1006**. The card's "+8165 lines / 3+ features" figure is stale by roughly 5x.

What the 176 paths actually are, so the follow-up does not have to re-derive it:
- `.codx` control-plane churn — the bulk of the count (shift cards, `autonomy/state.json`, `harness/audit.jsonl` +1076). Not product code, but it **pollutes every diff-based gate** (that is `b7225e63`).
- Feature A — voice: `src/api/modules/voice.js` (added, +101), 8 `tests/voice*.test.mjs`, `src/utils/voice/*`.
- Feature B — browsers/computers: `modules/browsers.js` +65, `modules/computers.js` +140.
- Feature C — `src/views/CompanyView.vue` (+774 / -262), `ProjectSettings.vue` (+74/-5), `GlobalSettings.vue` (+23).
- Feature D — CISO UI: untracked `src/views/CisoView.vue`, `src/api/modules/ciso.js`.
- M1 slice — **4 paths only** (`efforts.js` +8/-3, `EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` +3/-5, `package.json` +1/-1).

Scope correction this card must carry: `package.json` belongs to the M1 commit (it repairs an unsatisfiable `^2.0.3`; the registry 404s that version and HEAD's own lockfile pins `0.2.3`). So the remaining work is **172 paths across 4 features**, each needing its own card, owner and date before it gets a commit path — not 175.

No new card created for the 4 features yet: the honest next step is a scoping decision at the 11-20T16:00Z go/no-go (`53ed97fc`), because each of them needs a demo and a date, not just a commit.

## PM shift 12 (2026-11-23T09:10Z) — RE-MEASURED: the tree is now small, coherent and committable in 6 slices. This is no longer a "+8165 lines" problem.

`project_changes(scope=all, base=HEAD)` right now: **34 files, +1087/−2007**. Sixteen of those files are `.codx/` control-plane churn (task JSON, audit log, autonomy state). The **source** change is **17 files ≈ +634/−84**, plus one new file `src/components/company/CompanyFiles.vue`.

| # | Slice | Files | Δ | Coherent? | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | **Company workspace** | `src/api/modules/companies.js`, `CompanyView.vue`, `CompanyWorkplace.vue`, `CompanyActivity.vue`, `company/i18n.js`, `company/CompanyFiles.vue` (new) | +252/−40 +new | yes — one feature, UI+API+i18n together | software_developer |
| S2 | **Kanban planning range** | `BoardResponsibilityModal.vue`, `board/FollowupView.vue`, `board/PlanningRangeFilter.vue`, `BoardManagementView.vue` | +88/−24 | yes — one planning surface | software_developer |
| S3 | **Task-ref validator** | `tools/validate_task_refs.py` (new, 159l), `tests/test_validate_task_refs.py` (new, 120l), `package.json` (+1) | +280 | yes — self-contained, tool+tests+script | software_developer |
| S4 | **Recurrence comment fix** | `kanban/TaskSettings.vue` | +3/−6 | yes — comment-only, no behaviour | software_developer |
| S5 | **Dev proxy** | `vite.config.ts` | +10/−1 | yes — dev-only, no prod impact | software_developer |
| S6 | **Scattered** | `router/index.ts` (+1), `store/project.js` (+1/−1), `layout/AppsSection.vue` (−12), `.codx/wiki/.vitepress/config.json` (+1/−1) | +3/−14 | **no** — needs an owner or a revert | **unowned → decision** |

### Why this matters more than the size
The old title said "3+ features and +8165 lines with no commit path". That was true on 11-19. It is **false today**: five of the six slices are single-purpose, small, and independently reviewable. What is still missing is not scoping — it is the **act of committing**, and that has two costs the team must not pay silently:
1. **Nothing can be reverted selectively.** Mixed in one commit, a bad company API change cannot be backed out without taking the kanban planning fix with it.
2. **Gate denominators stay wrong.** Every coverage/mapping ratio computed over a dirty tree counts these slices (`acc01b1f`), so the QA gate keeps returning a number nobody can act on.

### Proposed commit path (one increment, ~1h of dev work, no code change)
1. **C1 ← S3** (validator + tests + npm script). Lowest risk, zero product behaviour, unlocks `check:task-refs` for the whole board. Commit first.
2. **C2 ← S4 + S5** (comment fix + dev proxy). Both behaviour-free; S4 also closes the last real HIGH in the tree.
3. **C3 ← S1** (Company workspace) as its own commit, with a demo script: open a company → Files tab loads → activity feed shows entries → switch language.
4. **C4 ← S2** (kanban planning) as its own commit, demo: set a planning range → follow-up view filters to it → responsibility modal persists.
5. **C5 ← S6** — either name a purpose per file or revert; do not let it ride along.

**Deployability:** C1–C2 are deployable immediately (no behaviour). C3 and C4 are each deployable and demoable on their own — that is the agile requirement, and it is satisfiable *today*. **Gate caveat, stated up front:** none of the C1–C4 commits can be certified by `qa_review_changes` while the runner is dead (`b19676fe`, `91411767`); they can be committed and demoed, not automatically certified. That trade-off is management's call on `53ed97fc`.

**Owner:** `software_developer` (assigned). **Wake:** +1d — the next dev shift executes C1→C2 and reports; C3/C4 are re-planned after the demo.

## PM shift 12 (2026-11-23T09:12Z) — card moved to `doing`; the plan now has an execution card

The re-measurement above is the accepted state of this card. To stop it being a report and become delivery, I created the execution card:

**`ae7df213-05da-4fcc-85c5-b6861099840f`** — *Commit the pending client tree in coherent, revertible slices (6 commits)* — owner `software_developer`, priority high, due 2026-11-24, `wake_at` 2026-11-24T09:10Z, on `IT team / Working`.

It fixes the exact gap this card complains about: a pathspec-scoped, one-commit-per-slice path with named acceptance (`git status` clean except leftovers, `git log -6` mapping 1:1 to slices, test output pasted). It explicitly forbids `git add -A`, forbids smuggling unexplained files into a slice, and treats the missing node runtime (`91411767`) as a known condition rather than a valid reason to keep the tree uncommitted.

Board state corrections made this shift, for the record:
- `675c4695` (TaskSettings hidden comment) → **done**: the reword is in the tree; verified read-only.
- `6bde8a8c` (CISO gate record) → **done**: both blocking premises dead (`package.json:65` is `^0.2.3`, committed; the 5 "HIGH" `src/api` hits are doc comments — see `3088a6b8`).
- `69a6298b` (dead Review column) → **rejected**: premise disproven, cards were moved this shift.
- `3088a6b8` → **onhold**: findings are comments/JSDoc, no code to patch; `security_audit` is reporting on prose.
- `651535b1` → **done**: manifests agree, `0.2.3` resolves in the lockfile.
- `3a86fba9`, `91411767`, and the four gate-defect cards → **onhold**, wake moved to 2026-12-07 / 2026-11-30: they are platform decisions no commit in this repo can satisfy.

Next checkpoint on this card: 2026-11-25T09:30Z, after the commit card hands back and before the GO/NO-GO on `53ed97fc`.

Authoritative measurement this shift, `project_changes(scope='all', paths=[src, tests, tools, package.json])` vs `HEAD`:

- **Already at HEAD** (so NOT pending): `src/api/modules/efforts.js`, `EffortsSettings.vue`, the `profiles.delete` envelope fix, `tests/effortsApi|responseOptions|voice*.test.mjs`, and `package.json`'s `test` script. The efforts increment is committed — the tree no longer holds it.

So the remaining work is **5 revertible slices**, not 6, and no efforts slice is needed. Map + driver are in `ae7df213`'s latest comment (`tools/commit-slices.mjs`, `tests/commitSlices.test.mjs`).

Blocking cause of the missing commit path is now **named** instead of hand-waved: `create_pr_branch(worktree=true)` errors with *"Worktree path '…/codx-junior-platform/client-worktrees/…' must be outside the repository …; check the project's git_worktrees_path setting"* → new card `4f014b9b` (high, wake 2026-11-25T15:08Z).
